name: SiteHeader
summary: The top of a website: the name (and mark) linking home, the main places, and one or two actions. When its own width is narrow (below 48 rem) the places move behind a Menu button and open as a list under the bar. Not for an app's top bar (TitleBar) or for navigation within one section of pages (Navigation).
a11y: The places are a `nav` named by `label` with the current one marked `aria-current="page"`. In a narrow header, the Menu button (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`) opens the same places as a list; Escape or choosing a place closes it, and Escape returns focus to the button.

props.name: name
props.description: The site's or the person's name; links home.

props.name: href
props.description: Where the name leads, usually the home page.

props.name: mark
props.description: A small mark before the name (an Icon or a logo Image); decoration, so its alt text is empty.

props.name: links
props.description: The main places, in order. Keep it to about five; the rest belong in the footer.

props.name: actions
props.description: One or two Buttons at the end, the main one last: "Contact sales", "Get tickets". They stay in a narrow window.

props.name: current
props.description: The page being shown, or the section it belongs to: marked with `aria-current="page"` and a tint.
